name: extension_registry
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}extension_registries`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,revision BIGINT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY project_kind(project_id,kind)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}extension_versions`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,extension_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,version VARCHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY immutable_version(project_id,kind,extension_id,version)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
